summary: Independent backend re-verification of P0.1-B2 (transaction state machine + holds/reservations + available balance + anti-double-spend). Wrote 3 new pytest suites (32 new tests) using TRUE parallel HTTP (ThreadPoolExecutor) against the public preview URL. Results: 68/69 tests pass. All anti-double-spend / atomicity / idempotency / partial-capture / release / lazy-expiry / illegal-transition invariants HOLD, including at the capture-vs-expiry race boundary and under a randomized chaos load. One real defect found: the holds integrity report (and therefore GET /api/admin/financial-health severity) turns CRITICAL/unhealthy for any expired-but-not-yet-read hold, i.e. lazy-expiry produces a monitoring FALSE POSITIVE. Also fixed one stale assertion in the pre-existing backfill test (server no longer uses the static 'backfill:<acct>' idempotency key).

minor.issue: FALSE POSITIVE with lazy-expiry: holds_integrity_report() does not reconcile expired holds before comparing. A hold whose TTL lapsed and whose owner has not been read since is reported in held_mismatch (cache 40 vs effective 0) AND expired_still_active -> healthy=false -> financial-health severity=CRITICAL, even though funds are effectively free and self-heal on the next read. Since there is no expiry worker, this will fire routinely in production. Repro test: tests/test_p01b2_holds_race.py::TestLazyExpiryIntegrityFalsePositive (currently failing by design to document the bug). Fix: run reconcile_expired_holds (or treat expiry-pending remaining as effective 0 and not as a mismatch) inside the report, or downgrade 'expired_still_active' to an INFO/maintenance signal instead of a health breach.
Requires authentication (401 anonymous). Not a bug, but note for the review request which assumed it was public. Capability values verified honest once authenticated.

action_items: Make holds integrity / financial-health lazy-expiry aware so an untouched expired hold does not report severity=CRITICAL (only real defect found).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1482 lines and mixes ledger, holds, cards, admin, agents — split into routers/modules (>700 line rule).

capture_hold does the atomic $inc captured first, then a separate $set status and $inc held_cc: a crash in that window leaves status ACTIVE with captured incremented (funds stay locked = under-release, never over-spend). Acceptable per documented compensation strategy, but the rebuild endpoint is currently the only repair path — consider an outbox/worker so repair is not admin-manual.
get_or_seed_card has a duplicated find_one call (server.py ~L223-224) — dead line.

No expiry worker exists; lazy-expiry only triggers on user-scoped reads (wallet/holds/create_hold). Global admin reports therefore see stale state (see minor issue). A periodic reconcile job would remove the false positive entirely.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified with TRUE concurrency: (1) 10 concurrent holds of 20 on balance 100 -> accepted<=5, held==20*accepted, rows==accepted, all rejects 400 INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE_FUNDS; (2) 2x80 -> exactly 1 winner; (3) 5 concurrent releases -> held 0, no double credit; (4) 5 concurrent captures of 30 on a 50 hold -> exactly 1 success, balance debited once; (5) same Idempotency-Key x5 concurrent -> exactly ONE hold row/one reservation, losers 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS, later replay returns the same hold_id; same key + different payload -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; failed request does not poison the key; (6) partial capture 40 -> PARTIALLY_CAPTURED/remaining 60/balance 60/held 60, over-capture 61 -> 409, capture 60 -> CAPTURED, re-capture -> 409, history has None->ACTIVE->PARTIALLY_CAPTURED->CAPTURED; (7) release -> RELEASED, 2nd release idempotent, capture after release -> 409 with no balance change; (8) ttl_seconds=1 lazy-expiry frees funds without a worker, capture on expired -> 409, expired funds immediately reusable; (9) 8-iteration capture-vs-expiry race burst (both branches hit: 2 captures won, 6 expiries won) -> held_cc always == sum(remaining active), balance always == 100-captured, never negative, guard hold never freed; (10) chaos load (30 mixed concurrent ops) -> no 5xx, invariants + ledger_balanced hold; (11) capabilities honest (state_machines/holds/idempotency_api REAL, refund PLANNED, settlement PARTIAL, stripe SANDBOX, card MOCK); (12) cross-user capture/release -> 404, admin endpoints -> 403 for non-admin. Run holds suites SERIALLY (-n 0): admin integrity endpoints are GLOBAL and the pytest.ini 2-worker split causes cross-worker false mismatches (also affects backend_test.py::test_wallet_reachable which asserts a fixed 500 CC balance for a module-scoped user).
rca_of_the_issue: holds_integrity_report() compares users.held_cc against the sum of remaining amounts of ACTIVE/PARTIALLY_CAPTURED holds with expires_at > now, but it never calls reconcile_expired_holds first. Because expiry is lazy (only triggered by user-scoped reads) and no worker exists, a hold past its TTL still contributes to held_cc while being excluded from 'effective' -> held_mismatch + expired_still_active -> healthy=false -> financial-health severity=CRITICAL. This is a reporting/monitoring defect only: no funds are lost, over-reserved or double-spent, and a single GET /api/wallet (or POST /api/admin/holds/rebuild) self-heals it.
